ev.q: Approximately one third of adults reported an adequate level of leisure-time physical activity
More than half (56.4%) of adults reported doing no hard physical activity during the workday
approximately two thirds (63.9%) of employed adults in the United States do not meet current recommendations
Men were more active than women at both the moderate and vigorous level.
The survey used a probability sample of the U.S. civilian, noninstitutionalized population aged > 18 years

methods_quotes.q: Prevalence of activity was calculated by age, sex, race/ethnicity, and education level using SUDAAN to adjust for the complex sampling frame.
METs for each leisure-time physical activity were based on the Compendium of Physical Activities
